storyOfTheDay.title: Let the small things be enough.
storyOfTheDay.body: A reminder for the days you are finding your footing.

items.title: Make space for the pause
items.summary: A little room can show you what matters.
items.body: You do not have to fill every quiet moment with an answer. A little room can show you what matters.
items.author: Nora Bell

items.title: Beginning again still counts
items.summary: Starting over can be a way of meeting yourself where you are.
items.body: Starting over is not proof that you failed. It is proof that you are willing to meet yourself where you are.
items.author: Milo Hart

items.title: Notice the ordinary light
items.summary: A good life is often made of small, familiar returns.
items.body: A warm cup, a familiar song, an unhurried walk. A good life is often made of these small returns.
items.author: Elena Reed

items.title: Kindness has a long memory
items.summary: A gentle gesture can become a place someone rests.
items.body: The gentlest gesture can become a place someone rests long after the moment has passed.
items.author: Asa Quinn

items.title: Rest is part of the work
items.summary: Your worth does not rise and fall with your output.
items.body: Your worth does not rise and fall with your output. Let your body be a home you listen to.
items.author: June Avery
